Published AutoDock Vina1.2.3 WebAssembly build downloaded from https://github.com/durrantlab/molmoda/tree/main/public/js/webina (exact commit and wasm SHA256 in public/data/docking/results.json). Webina source https://github.com/durrantlab/webina (license copied as LICENSE-Webina.md). AutoDock Vina source https://github.com/ccsb-scripps/AutoDock-Vina, Apache License2.0; cite Eberhardt et al., J Chem Inf Model2021,61,3891–3898, DOI10.1021/acs.jcim.1c00203, and Trott & Olson, J Comput Chem2010,31,455–461, DOI10.1002/jcc.21334. The Node adapter is original glue, not a modified scoring function. The wasm binary and JS published loader are unmodified.
